Assuming this patch got re based on an earlier one?
Done
We don't need action result at this level.
Done

This API need not return a bool and action result as output variable 
Action result itself has the info stating whether the action succeeded or failed. So it is just duplicating the information.

Ideally just change the return type of this API from bool to "types::BaseActionResult". That should suffice.
Done

I did not get this part, why we need two? Why not just have one and get the result in that?

types::BaseActionResult l_actionResult = jsonUtility::executeBaseAction(...);
Done

What failed in the action should not concern API calling "parseVpdFile" the caller is not aware if there is any action associated with parsing of the file, so parseVpdFile should not return the whole structure to the caller.
Done
I did not under stand this part.
no more needed as I am traversing only presence now.

Here the code need to change, instead of  "l_errCode" action result presence error code needs to be checked to get the exact value of presence. This error code can have reason related to failure of any other tag.
Done

Parse VPD should not change the presence of any FRU. Its responsibility is just to parse the VPD if successfully or return error that happened in the process of doing that.

So ideally, instead of returning the base action, you need to return the presence that was detected in this process.
Done
Update the returned tuple to return the presence of the FRU, full base action is irrelevant in this API.
Done
Ideally this API based on the presence value received from "parseVpdFile" should update the present property on Dbus as it holds the responsibility of parsing and publishing.
Done
Same here, base action is not required at this point, this API is not aware of any base action. Here only presence needs to be handled and returned back to the caller.
Done
There is no such parameter. Please remove this.
not required.
Why was this modified.
not required.
It returns both, the return type has a tuple of both then why the comment says only the presence will be returned?
updated.
Why this condition needs to be checked here? Only presence error code would do?
Done
It is a duplicate code, can be optimized?
Done
Do we need to handle presence in this flow as well?

This is collectSingleFru flow. I have handled collectFruVpd flow here.
If fru was deleted before or not handled so far, its presence would be false.
When user explicitly collects it, its presence should be updated on DBUS.
Handled.
